methodology: Cumulative AI cost over 24 months. Cloud usage tiers calibrated to GPT-4o blended pricing (input $2.50/M, output $10/M, typical input-heavy retrieval workloads land around $5/M blended). Local AI Station: one-time hardware (128 GB unified-memory APU build) + ongoing electricity at $0.15/kWh, 200W average.

local_station.notes: Comparable consumer + workstation builds land in the $2,400–$3,500 range, depending on chassis and storage. $25/mo opex covers electricity at typical SMB rates.
